# Libre Computer Board Power

> Power tree for Libre Computer boards: which regulator feeds which rail, what switches it, and which rails are on in each power state, from each board's own netlist or published schematic.

Part of Libre Computer (https://libre.computer/llms.txt). Each board's page lists its power rails as HTML: voltage, what makes each rail and how it is switched, and what it feeds.

## Boards

- [Le Potato AML-S905X-CC](https://power.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s905x-cc/): 17 rails; input DC_5V_IN 5 V from Micro-USB; at 5, 3.3, 1.8, 1.5 V; made by 3 load switches, 4 bucks, 2 LDOs
- [Sweet Potato AML-S905X-CC-V2](https://power.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s905x-cc-v2/): 22 rails; input DC_5V_IN 5 V from USB-C; at 5, 3.3, 2.5, 1.8, 1.2, 0.9 V; made by 4 load switches, 4 bucks, 4 LDOs
- [La Frite AML-S805X-AC](https://power.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s805x-ac/): 16 rails; input VBUS_5V 5 V from Micro-USB; at 5, 3.3, 2.5, 1.8, 1.2 V; made by 4 bucks, 3 LDOs
- [Das Frite AML-S805X-AC-V2](https://power.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s805x-ac-v2/): 14 rails; input VBUS_5V 5 V from USB-C; at 5, 3.3, 2.5, 1.8, 1.2 V; made by 4 bucks, 3 LDOs
- [Alta AML-A311D-CC](https://power.hardware.libre.computer/aml-a311d-cc/): 20 rails; input 5V_IN 5 V from USB-C; at 5, 3.3, 1.8, 1.1, 0.8 V; made by 2 load switches, 5 bucks, 4 LDOs
- [Solitude AML-S905D3-CC](https://power.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s905d3-cc/): 20 rails; input 5V_IN 5 V from USB-C; at 5, 3.3, 1.8, 1.1, 0.8 V; made by 2 load switches, 4 bucks, 4 LDOs
- [Renegade ROC-RK3328-CC](https://power.hardware.libre.computer/roc-rk3328-cc/): 28 rails; input VCC_SYS 5 V from Micro-USB; at 5, 3.3, 2.5, 1.8, 1 V; made by 3 load switches, 5 bucks, 5 LDOs
- [Tritium ALL-H3-CC](https://power.hardware.libre.computer/all-h3-cc/): 14 rails; input DC_5V_IN 5 V from Micro-USB; at 5, 3.3, 1.2, 1.1 V; made by 2 LDOs, 1 load switch, 4 bucks
- [Renegade Elite ROC-RK3399-PC](https://power.hardware.libre.computer/roc-rk3399-pc/): 40 rails; input VBUS_TYPEC0 from USB-C; at 12, 5, 3.3, 3, 1.8, 1.5, 1.135, 1, 0.9 V; made by 8 load switches, 12 bucks, 13 LDOs
